premise: Speedy Sandpiper races slow Hermit Crab and Turtle to the rock pool, but keeps stopping for snacks; the slow two arrive first, chatting, and Sandpiper says he won the most snacks.
inspiration: Aesop's tortoise and hare with three runners and no gloating: the slow ones arrive together, and the fast one has his own kind of prize.
lesson: Slow and steady gets there, and everyone has their own win.

en-US.title: The Slow Race
en-US.text: [excited] A race to the rock pool! {sandpiper:enter} {sandpiper:face happy} Sandpiper hopped from foot to foot. {sandpiper:live jump} I'm the fastest! {hermit-crab:enter} {hermit-crab:go to sandpiper} Hermit Crab sighed. {hermit-crab:face sad} I'm very slow. {turtle:enter} {turtle:go to hermit-crab} [slowly] And I'm… even… slower, said Turtle. {turtle:face happy} Ready, steady… GO! {sandpiper:go to shore right by run} Zip! Off ran Sandpiper. {hermit-crab:go to pool} {turtle:go to pool} Hermit Crab and Turtle set off, step… by step… [short pause] But halfway there, Sandpiper spotted something tasty. {sandpiper:live peck} Peck, peck, peck! Then something else. {sandpiper:hop} Peck, peck! Hermit Crab and Turtle just kept going, {turtle:live talk} chatting all the way. {hermit-crab:face happy} And who reached the pool first? [gasps] Hermit Crab and Turtle, {hermit-crab:face surprised} together! {hermit-crab:live hide} Hermit Crab was so surprised he popped into his shell, and peeked out again. {turtle:live peek} Turtle tucked her head in, and peeked out too, smiling. [laughs] At last, {sandpiper:go to pool by run} along came Sandpiper, last of all. I lost, he said, {sandpiper:hop x2} but I won the most snacks! {hermit-crab:hearts} {turtle:hearts}

es-ES.title: La carrera lenta
es-ES.text: [excited] ¡Una carrera hasta la charca! {sandpiper:enter} {sandpiper:face happy} Correlimos saltaba de una pata a otra. {sandpiper:live jump} ¡Yo soy el más rápido! {hermit-crab:enter} {hermit-crab:go to sandpiper} Cangrejo Ermitaño suspiró. {hermit-crab:face sad} Yo soy muy lento. {turtle:enter} {turtle:go to hermit-crab} [slowly] Y yo… todavía… más lenta, dijo Tortuga. {turtle:face happy} Preparados, listos… ¡YA! {sandpiper:go to shore right by run} ¡Zas! Allá fue Correlimos. {hermit-crab:go to pool} {turtle:go to pool} Ermitaño y Tortuga salieron, paso… a paso… [short pause] Pero a medio camino, Correlimos vio algo rico. {sandpiper:live peck} ¡Pic, pic, pic! Luego otra cosa. {sandpiper:hop} ¡Pic, pic! Ermitaño y Tortuga siguieron andando, {turtle:live talk} charlando todo el rato. {hermit-crab:face happy} ¿Y quién llegó primero a la charca? [gasps] ¡Ermitaño y Tortuga, {hermit-crab:face surprised} a la vez! {hermit-crab:live hide} Ermitaño se sorprendió tanto que se metió en su concha, y volvió a asomarse. {turtle:live peek} Tortuga escondió la cabeza, y también se asomó, sonriendo. [laughs] Por fin, {sandpiper:go to pool by run} llegó Correlimos, el último. He perdido, dijo, {sandpiper:hop x2} ¡pero he ganado más meriendas! {hermit-crab:hearts} {turtle:hearts}

ja-JP.title: ゆっくり きょうそう
ja-JP.text: [excited]潮だまりまで、きょうそうだ！{sandpiper:enter}{sandpiper:face happy}シギくんは、あしぶみして、うずうず。{sandpiper:live jump}「ぼくが、いちばんはやいよ！」 {hermit-crab:enter}{hermit-crab:go to sandpiper}ヤドカリくんは、ふうっとためいき。{hermit-crab:face sad}「ぼく、すごくおそいんだ」 {turtle:enter}{turtle:go to hermit-crab}[slowly]「わたしは…もっと…おそいわよ」 とウミガメさん。{turtle:face happy}よーい…ドン！{sandpiper:go to shore right by run}ピューッ！シギくんは、かけだしました。{hermit-crab:go to pool}{turtle:go to pool}ヤドカリくんとウミガメさんは、いっぽ…いっぽ…[short pause]でも、シギくん、とちゅうで、おいしそうなもの、みーつけた！{sandpiper:live peck}つんつんつん！また、べつのもの。{sandpiper:hop}つんつん！ヤドカリくんとウミガメさんは、{turtle:live talk}おしゃべりしながら、こつこつ、すすみます。{hermit-crab:face happy}さあ、さきに潮だまりについたのは？[gasps]ヤドカリくんとウミガメさん、{hermit-crab:face surprised}いっしょに！{hermit-crab:live hide}ヤドカリくんは、びっくりして、かいがらにすっぽり。それから、ひょっこり。{turtle:live peek}ウミガメさんも、くびをひっこめて、にこにこ、ひょっこり。[laughs]さいごに、{sandpiper:go to pool by run}いちばんびりのシギくんが、とうちゃく。「まけちゃった」 とシギくん。{sandpiper:hop x2}「でも、おやつなら、ぼくのかち！」 {hermit-crab:hearts}{turtle:hearts}

de-DE.title: Das langsame Wettrennen
de-DE.text: [excited] Ein Wettrennen bis zum Tümpel! {sandpiper:enter} {sandpiper:face happy} Der Strandläufer hüpfte von einem Fuß auf den anderen. {sandpiper:live jump} „Ich bin der Schnellste!“ {hermit-crab:enter} {hermit-crab:go to sandpiper} Der Einsiedlerkrebs seufzte. {hermit-crab:face sad} „Ich bin sehr langsam.“ {turtle:enter} {turtle:go to hermit-crab} [slowly] „Und ich bin… noch… langsamer“, sagte die Meeresschildkröte. {turtle:face happy} „Auf die Plätze, fertig… LOS!“ {sandpiper:go to shore right by run} Zack! Weg war der Strandläufer. {hermit-crab:go to pool} {turtle:go to pool} Der Einsiedlerkrebs und die Schildkröte machten sich auf den Weg, Schritt… für Schritt… [short pause] Aber auf halber Strecke entdeckte der Strandläufer etwas Leckeres. {sandpiper:live peck} Pick, pick, pick! Und dann noch etwas. {sandpiper:hop} Pick, pick! Die beiden Langsamen liefen einfach weiter {turtle:live talk} und plauderten den ganzen Weg. {hermit-crab:face happy} Und wer kam zuerst am Tümpel an? [gasps] Der Einsiedlerkrebs und die Schildkröte, {hermit-crab:face surprised} zusammen! {hermit-crab:live hide} Der Einsiedlerkrebs war so überrascht, dass er in sein Schneckenhaus schlüpfte und wieder herauslugte. {turtle:live peek} Die Schildkröte zog den Kopf ein und lugte auch wieder heraus, mit einem Lächeln. [laughs] Endlich {sandpiper:go to pool by run} kam auch der Strandläufer angerannt, als Allerletzter. „Ich hab verloren“, sagte er, {sandpiper:hop x2} „aber dafür hab ich am meisten genascht!“ {hermit-crab:hearts} {turtle:hearts}

fr-FR.title: La course la plus lente
fr-FR.text: [excited] Une course jusqu’à la mare ! {sandpiper:enter} {sandpiper:face happy} Bécasseau sautillait d’une patte sur l’autre. {sandpiper:live jump} « C’est moi le plus rapide ! » {hermit-crab:enter} {hermit-crab:go to sandpiper} Bernard-l’ermite a soupiré. {hermit-crab:face sad} « Moi, je suis très lent. » {turtle:enter} {turtle:go to hermit-crab} [slowly] « Et moi… encore… plus lente », a dit Tortue de mer. {turtle:face happy} À vos marques, prêts… PARTEZ ! {sandpiper:go to shore right by run} Zou ! Bécasseau a filé. {hermit-crab:go to pool} {turtle:go to pool} Bernard-l’ermite et Tortue sont partis, pas… à pas… [short pause] Mais à mi-chemin, Bécasseau a vu quelque chose de bon à manger. {sandpiper:live peck} Pic, pic, pic ! Puis autre chose. {sandpiper:hop} Pic, pic ! Bernard-l’ermite et Tortue, eux, avançaient toujours, {turtle:live talk} en bavardant tout le long du chemin. {hermit-crab:face happy} Et qui est arrivé le premier à la mare ? [gasps] Bernard-l’ermite et Tortue, {hermit-crab:face surprised} ensemble ! {hermit-crab:live hide} Bernard-l’ermite était si surpris qu’il est rentré dans sa coquille, puis il a pointé le bout du nez. {turtle:live peek} Tortue a rentré la tête, et elle l’a ressortie, elle aussi, avec un grand sourire. [laughs] Enfin, {sandpiper:go to pool by run} Bécasseau est arrivé, le tout dernier. « J’ai perdu la course, a-t-il dit, {sandpiper:hop x2} mais j’ai gagné le plus de goûters ! » {hermit-crab:hearts} {turtle:hearts}

it-IT.title: La gara lenta lenta
it-IT.text: [excited] Una gara fino alla pozza! {sandpiper:enter} {sandpiper:face happy} Piovanello saltellava da una zampa all'altra. {sandpiper:live jump} «Io sono il più veloce!» {hermit-crab:enter} {hermit-crab:go to sandpiper} Paguro ha sospirato. {hermit-crab:face sad} «Io sono lentissimo.» {turtle:enter} {turtle:go to hermit-crab} [slowly] «E io… ancora… più lenta», ha detto Tartaruga marina. {turtle:face happy} «Pronti, partenza… VIA!» {sandpiper:go to shore right by run} Zac! Piovanello è partito di corsa. {hermit-crab:go to pool} {turtle:go to pool} Paguro e Tartaruga si sono incamminati, passo… dopo… passo… [short pause] Ma a metà strada, Piovanello ha visto qualcosa di buono. {sandpiper:live peck} Becca, becca, becca! Poi un'altra cosa. {sandpiper:hop} Becca, becca! Paguro e Tartaruga, invece, andavano avanti, {turtle:live talk} chiacchierando per tutta la strada. {hermit-crab:face happy} E chi è arrivato per primo alla pozza? [gasps] Paguro e Tartaruga, {hermit-crab:face surprised} insieme! {hermit-crab:live hide} Paguro era così sorpreso che si è infilato nella conchiglia, e poi ha sbirciato fuori. {turtle:live peek} Tartaruga ha ritirato la testa, e poi ha fatto capolino anche lei, sorridendo. [laughs] Alla fine, {sandpiper:go to pool by run} è arrivato Piovanello, ultimo di tutti. «Ho perso», ha detto, {sandpiper:hop x2} «ma ho vinto più spuntini di tutti!» {hermit-crab:hearts} {turtle:hearts}

zh-TW.title: 慢吞吞賽跑
zh-TW.text: [excited]大家來比賽，看誰先跑到潮池！{sandpiper:enter}{sandpiper:face happy}濱鷸兩隻腳輪流跳呀跳。{sandpiper:live jump}「我跑最快！」 {hermit-crab:enter}{hermit-crab:go to sandpiper}寄居蟹嘆了一口氣。{hermit-crab:face sad}「我好慢喔。」 {turtle:enter}{turtle:go to hermit-crab}[slowly]「我……比你……還要慢。」 海龜說。{turtle:face happy}「預備——開始！」 {sandpiper:go to shore right by run}咻！濱鷸跑走了。{hermit-crab:go to pool}{turtle:go to pool}寄居蟹和海龜也出發了，一步……一步……[short pause]可是跑到一半，濱鷸看到了好吃的東西。{sandpiper:live peck}啄、啄、啄！又看到一個。{sandpiper:hop}啄、啄！寄居蟹和海龜一直往前走，{turtle:live talk}一路聊個不停。{hermit-crab:face happy}最後，是誰先到潮池呢？[gasps]是寄居蟹和海龜，{hermit-crab:face surprised}一起到的！{hermit-crab:live hide}寄居蟹嚇了一大跳，咻地躲進殼裡，又探出頭來。{turtle:live peek}海龜也把頭縮進去，再探出來，笑咪咪的。[laughs]最後，{sandpiper:go to pool by run}濱鷸才跑過來，是最後一名。「我輸了，」 牠說，{sandpiper:hop x2}「可是我吃到的點心最多！」 {hermit-crab:hearts}{turtle:hearts}

zh-HK.title: 慢慢鬥快
zh-HK.text: [excited]鬥快去石池！{sandpiper:enter}{sandpiper:face happy}濱鷸兩隻腳輪流跳呀跳。{sandpiper:live jump}「我最快㗎！」 {hermit-crab:enter}{hermit-crab:go to sandpiper}寄居蟹嘆了一口氣。{hermit-crab:face sad}「我好慢㗎。」 {turtle:enter}{turtle:go to hermit-crab}[slowly]「我……仲……要慢啲，」 海龜說。{turtle:face happy}「預備……起！」 {sandpiper:go to shore right by run}咻！濱鷸一下子跑走了。{hermit-crab:go to pool}{turtle:go to pool}寄居蟹和海龜也出發了，一步……一步……[short pause]可是跑到一半，濱鷸看見了好吃的東西。{sandpiper:live peck}啄、啄、啄！然後，又看見別的。{sandpiper:hop}啄、啄！寄居蟹和海龜一直向前走，{turtle:live talk}一邊走，一邊聊天。{hermit-crab:face happy}誰最先到達石池呢？[gasps]是寄居蟹和海龜，{hermit-crab:face surprised}同時到達！{hermit-crab:live hide}寄居蟹驚訝得啵一聲縮進殼裏，又再探頭出來。{turtle:live peek}海龜也把頭縮進去，再笑着探出來。[laughs]最後，{sandpiper:go to pool by run}濱鷸才跑到，是最後一個。「我輸咗，」 牠說，{sandpiper:hop x2}「但係我食得最多呀！」 {hermit-crab:hearts}{turtle:hearts}
